text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh~ My cowlick just won't stay 
down~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Stand up properly, c'mon~! Yes, just like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, it tilted! A little more to the 
right... like 4mm...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more... and yet... Aaargh... 
it's just not coming together~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft was feeling down because her 
hair just wouldn't sit right.
